name: Mild Chicken or Lamb Korma (Smooth Sauce)
whyItWorks: Braised meat in a mild, velvety sauce made from cream/yogurt, mild aromatic spices, and smooth nut paste (zero whole nut shards).
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order 0/10 mild over white basmati rice and verify no whole raisins or whole cashews are mixed into the sauce.
